headline: Apple beats holiday-quarter expectations and lifts iPhone outlook
body: Apple reported fiscal first-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations, citing stronger iPhone Pro demand and services growth. Management also raised second-quarter revenue guidance and said gross margin should expand modestly.

signal.summary: Apple beat expectations and lifted near-term guidance on stronger iPhone demand.

headline: Nike misses margin expectations as inventories stay elevated
body: Nike posted quarterly sales roughly in line with consensus but gross margin fell more than analysts expected after additional promotions. Executives warned that North America demand remains choppy into the next quarter.

signal.summary: Nike's weaker margins and cautious commentary point to downside pressure after earnings.
risks: Promotional activity could normalize faster than expected

headline: Salesforce raises full-year profit guidance after strong renewals
body: Salesforce said enterprise renewals improved late in the quarter and raised its full-year operating margin and earnings guidance. The company kept revenue guidance intact but highlighted improving deal conversion.

signal.summary: Salesforce's higher profit outlook signals better execution and renewals momentum.

headline: Snowflake cuts product revenue forecast amid slower cloud optimization recovery
body: Snowflake lowered its fiscal-year product revenue forecast, saying customer optimization behavior is persisting longer than expected. Management said large-deal timing remains unpredictable in the second half.

signal.summary: Snowflake reduced forward guidance because optimization headwinds are lasting longer than expected.

headline: Chevron to acquire Hess in all-stock deal focused on Guyana exposure
body: Chevron agreed to buy Hess in an all-stock transaction valued at $53 billion, adding a major stake in Guyana's offshore assets. Chevron expects the deal to be accretive to free cash flow within a year of closing.

signal.summary: Hess shares gain a takeover catalyst from Chevron's all-stock acquisition offer.
risks: Regulatory or arbitration delays could slow closing

headline: Paramount explores merger that could dilute existing shareholders
body: Paramount Global said its special committee is evaluating a merger proposal that would combine the media company with a rival streaming operator. Investors focused on the possibility of a large equity issuance and asset sales tied to the plan.

signal.summary: The proposed merger introduces dilution and restructuring risk for Paramount shareholders.

headline: FDA issues complete response letter for small-cap biotech liver therapy
body: The FDA declined to approve Madrigal competitor HepaNova's experimental liver therapy, citing manufacturing deficiencies and the need for additional safety follow-up. Shares fell sharply in premarket trading.

signal.summary: An FDA complete response letter creates a major regulatory setback for HepaNova.

headline: Coinbase rallies after SEC signals progress on spot crypto ETF framework
body: The SEC released a framework update that analysts said improves the odds of additional spot crypto ETF approvals. Coinbase, which provides custody for multiple issuers, rose on expectations of higher institutional activity.

signal.summary: A more favorable SEC framework could support Coinbase through higher ETF-related activity.

headline: S&P 500 futures rise as Fed officials open door to summer rate cuts
body: Two Federal Reserve officials said disinflation is broadening and the central bank could begin cutting rates this summer if labor markets remain orderly. Equity index futures and rate-sensitive sectors outperformed in early trading.

signal.summary: Dovish Fed commentary boosts broad equities through lower-rate expectations.
risks: Inflation data could reverse the narrative

headline: Hot CPI print knocks futures lower and pushes Treasury yields up
body: U.S. consumer prices rose more than expected in April, prompting traders to price out near-term Federal Reserve easing. Mega-cap technology stocks and homebuilders led the premarket decline while Treasury yields climbed.

signal.summary: A hotter CPI reading pressures equities by delaying rate-cut expectations.
risks: Markets may fade the move if subsequent data cools

headline: Tesla director buys $5 million of stock after recent pullback
body: A Tesla board member disclosed an open-market purchase of roughly $5 million in shares, according to a Form 4 filing. The buy came days after a sharp selloff tied to softer vehicle delivery expectations.

signal.summary: A sizable insider purchase suggests confidence after Tesla's recent pullback.
risks: Fundamentals may continue to weaken despite insider support

headline: Nvidia CFO sells part of stake under prearranged trading plan
body: An SEC filing showed Nvidia's chief financial officer sold roughly $18 million worth of shares as part of a previously disclosed Rule 10b5-1 plan. The stock remained near record highs following the transaction.

signal.summary: An insider sale is a watch item, but the planned nature of the transaction softens the signal.
risks: Prearranged sales often have limited predictive value

headline: Microsoft unveils redesigned Teams features at annual developer event
body: Microsoft showcased new Teams collaboration features, including AI-generated meeting summaries and improved integrations with internal workflow tools. The announcement did not include pricing changes, customer wins, or updated financial targets.

expected.reason: Product updates without quantified financial impact or a tradable catalyst should not be extracted as a market signal.

headline: Reports conflict on whether Microsoft or another bidder is leading Activision talks
body: Two media reports gave conflicting accounts of renewed acquisition interest around Activision Blizzard, with one naming Microsoft and another pointing to a private-equity consortium. Neither report cited documents or board confirmation.

expected.reason: The article presents conflicting takeover narratives and does not support one clear signal extraction.

headline: Dell beats on AI server demand and sees backlog extending into next year
body: Dell reported stronger-than-expected infrastructure revenue, driven by AI server orders from enterprise and cloud customers. Management said the AI backlog now stretches into next fiscal year and supports continued margin expansion.

signal.summary: Dell's earnings beat and expanding AI server backlog support a positive post-earnings read-through.
risks: Enterprise hardware spending can remain cyclical

headline: Southwest trims second-half capacity plan and warns on unit revenue
body: Southwest Airlines said it will reduce second-half capacity growth after softer domestic bookings and aircraft delivery delays. The company also lowered its outlook for unit revenue trends in the current quarter.

signal.summary: Southwest lowered operating expectations as demand and aircraft constraints pressure the outlook.
risks: Fuel or fare conditions could improve later in the year

headline: Amazon to buy healthcare subscription startup in strategic tuck-in deal
body: Amazon agreed to acquire private startup CareLane to deepen its consumer healthcare offering. Analysts said the purchase is small financially but strategically relevant for Amazon's cross-selling ambitions in pharmacy and primary care.

signal.summary: Amazon's tuck-in acquisition supports its longer-term healthcare expansion strategy.
risks: Near-term financial impact is likely modest

headline: Alphabet hit with fresh EU antitrust fine tied to ad-tech practices
body: European regulators fined Alphabet €3.2 billion and ordered changes to parts of its advertising technology business. Analysts said the ruling could pressure margins and complicate product bundling in Europe.

signal.summary: The EU fine and mandated ad-tech changes create a negative regulatory overhang for Alphabet.
risks: Alphabet could appeal or limit the operational impact

headline: Gold ETF demand rises as bond yields slide after weak payrolls report
body: A softer-than-expected U.S. payrolls report pushed Treasury yields lower and revived expectations for central-bank easing. Gold prices rose and ETF inflows accelerated as investors rotated toward defensive real assets.

signal.summary: Weaker payrolls data supports gold through lower yields and renewed easing expectations.
risks: A rebound in yields could reverse the move

headline: JPMorgan director adds to holdings after regional-bank volatility
body: A JPMorgan director purchased $1.8 million of stock on the open market, according to a late Friday SEC filing. The transaction follows a week of volatility across regional banks and renewed debate over deposit competition.

signal.summary: A director's open-market purchase signals confidence during sector volatility.
risks: Broader banking contagion could outweigh insider support
